ksis.name: Defining Functionality and Privileges

ksis.name: Enforcing Intended State

ksis.name: Implementing Best Practices

methods.description: The latest benchmark scan has no failed controls

ksis.coverage_note: Official statement covers user and non-user accounts and a persistent review; methods check privileged human access only.

ksis.name: Operating SIEM Capability

ksis.name: Reviewing Logs
ksis.coverage_note: Official statement requires logs to be audited; methods check review recency and triage, not audit quality.
